mapper.sql: downgrade.downgrade_id, downgrade.request_id, downgrade.user_id, quota.user_code, downgrade.grant_id, downgrade.grant_ids, downgrade.package_id, storage_package.package_code, COALESCE(downgrade.package_names, storage_package.package_name) AS package_name, downgrade.package_names, downgrade.change_bytes, downgrade.request_source, downgrade.request_type, downgrade.downgrade_status, downgrade.grant_source, downgrade.before_quota_bytes, downgrade.target_quota_bytes, downgrade.used_bytes_snapshot, downgrade.reserved_bytes_snapshot, downgrade.overage_bytes, downgrade.reason, downgrade.review_remark, downgrade.grace_deadline, downgrade.related_recycle_id, requester.user_code AS requested_by_code, reviewer.user_code AS reviewed_by_code, downgrade.requested_time, downgrade.reviewed_time, downgrade.completed_time, downgrade.error_message

FROM byai.po_user_storage_downgrade downgrade INNER JOIN byai.po_user_storage_quota quota ON quota.user_id = downgrade.user_id AND quota.delete_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN byai.po_storage_package storage_package ON storage_package.package_id = downgrade.package_id LEFT JOIN byai.po_users requester ON requester.user_id = downgrade.requested_by LEFT JOIN byai.po_users reviewer ON reviewer.user_id = downgrade.reviewed_by
